The tool used for writing is a pen, pencil, keyboard, or any other instrument used to inscribe text.

To enhance your writing skills, consider the following performance improvement strategies:

1. Establish a consistent writing schedule and practice daily to build discipline and fluency.
2. Participate in writing workshops, courses, or groups to receive constructive feedback and maintain accountability.
3. Read a wide variety of literature to understand different styles and expand your narrative techniques.
